title: Dynamic symbol — hero video poster
slide_intent: Show how an enlarged fragment can carry a recognizable identity before the viewer reads a name.
strategic_value: The red and blue surfaces can make Swisscom’s symbol a recurring visual reference even when the complete lockup is absent.
demonstration: The supplied static video poster crops a red-and-blue folded form against white, placing the form at the left and leaving the right half largely open. No movement is observable in the saved image.
practical_value: Compare the recognition supplied by the colored surfaces with the space available for other content; this poster does not establish animation timing.

content_islands.name: Cropped form
content_islands.spec: Place the enlarged red and blue surfaces against the left edge, extending beyond the top and bottom of the frame.

content_islands.name: Open white field
content_islands.spec: Leave the right half white so the curved colored edges remain distinct.

ingredient.name: Cropped dynamic symbol
ingredient.role: Provide an expressive brand cue through the symbol’s color and curved surfaces.
ingredient.application: Use an enlarged crop as demonstrated here, retaining a clear white field beside it.
ingredient.scope: An observed hero-poster composition from the Moving Brands case study, not a prescribed crop or motion rule.

reference_purposes.Expression: The poster presents the red and blue curved surfaces at large scale on white.
